```{=html}
<div class="pbp-kelompok-search">
  <input type="search" id="kelompokSearchInput" class="form-control form-control-lg" autocomplete="off">
  <div class="pbp-kelompok-filters">
    <select id="kelasFilter" class="form-select"></select>
    <select id="asdosFilter" class="form-select"></select>
  </div>
  <div class="pbp-kelompok-meta">
    <span id="countLabel"></span>
    <span id="totalLabel" class="text-muted"></span>
  </div>
  <div id="kelompokResults"></div>
</div>

<style>
.pbp-kelompok-search { margin-top: 1rem; }
.pbp-kelompok-search #kelompokSearchInput {
  border-radius: 999px;
  padding: .7rem 1.3rem;
  border-width: 1.5px;
  transition: box-shadow .2s ease, border-color .2s ease;
}
.pbp-kelompok-search #kelompokSearchInput:focus {
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 .2rem rgba(13, 110, 253, .15);
}
.pbp-kelompok-filters { display: flex; gap: .6rem; margin-top: .7rem; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.pbp-kelompok-filters select {
  max-width: 240px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  padding: .45rem 1.1rem;
  border-width: 1.5px;
  transition: box-shadow .2s ease, border-color .2s ease;
}
.pbp-kelompok-filters select:focus {
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 .2rem rgba(13, 110, 253, .15);
}
.pbp-kelompok-meta { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; margin: .7rem 0 1.2rem; font-size: .85rem; }
.pbp-kelompok-search .pbp-card { margin-bottom: .8rem; }
.pbp-kelompok-search .kp-badges { display: flex; gap: .4rem; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; }
.pbp-kelompok-search .kp-asdos { margin-top: .5rem; font-size: .9rem; }
.pbp-kelompok-search .kp-asdos a { text-decoration: none; }
.pbp-kelompok-search .kp-members-label { margin-top: .7rem; font-size: .82rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .03em; opacity: .6; }
.pbp-kelompok-search .kp-members { margin: .35rem 0 0; padding-left: 1.15rem; }
.pbp-kelompok-search .kp-members li { padding: .1rem 0; }
.pbp-kelompok-search .kp-members li.kp-member-match { font-weight: 600; }
.pbp-kelompok-search .kp-empty { text-align: center; opacity: .65; padding: 2.5rem 1rem; }
.pbp-kelompok-search mark { background: rgba(47,95,219,.28); color: inherit; border-radius: 3px; padding: 0 1px; }
.quarto-dark .pbp-kelompok-search mark { background: rgba(123,161,255,.4); }
</style>

  const isEn = document.documentElement.lang === 'en';
  const T = isEn ? {
    placeholder: 'Type your name...',
    allKelas: 'All Classes',
    allAsdos: 'All TAs',
    kelasLabel: 'Class',
    kelompokLabel: 'Group',
    asdosLabel: 'TA:',
    membersLabel: 'Members',
    total: (n, g) => `${n} students in ${g} groups`,
    startHint: 'Start typing, or use the filters above.',
    noResult: 'No results. Check the spelling of the name.',
    resultCount: n => `${n} group(s) found`,
  } : {
    placeholder: 'Ketik nama kamu...',
    allKelas: 'Semua Kelas',
    allAsdos: 'Semua Asdos',
    kelasLabel: 'Kelas',
    kelompokLabel: 'Kelompok',
    asdosLabel: 'Asdos:',
    membersLabel: 'Anggota',
    total: (n, g) => `${n} mahasiswa dalam ${g} kelompok`,
    startHint: 'Mulai ketik nama di kotak pencarian, atau gunakan filter di atas.',
    noResult: 'Tidak ada hasil. Coba periksa ejaan nama.',
    resultCount: n => `${n} kelompok ditemukan`,
  };

  // group students by kelas + kelompok
  const groupsMap = new Map();
  for (const s of STUDENTS) {
    const key = s.kelas + '-' + s.kelompok;
    if (!groupsMap.has(key)) {
      groupsMap.set(key, {
        kelas: s.kelas,
        kelompok: s.kelompok,
        kodeAsdos: s.kodeAsdos,
        namaAsdos: s.namaAsdos,
        githubAsdos: s.githubAsdos,
        members: [],
      });
    }
    groupsMap.get(key).members.push({ nama: s.nama });
  }
  const kelasOrder = ['A', 'B', 'C', 'D', 'E', 'F', 'KKI'];
  const GROUPS = [...groupsMap.values()].sort((a, b) => {
    const ka = kelasOrder.indexOf(a.kelas), kb = kelasOrder.indexOf(b.kelas);
    if (ka !== kb) return ka - kb;
    return a.kelompok - b.kelompok;
  });

  const searchInput = document.getElementById('kelompokSearchInput');
  const kelasFilter = document.getElementById('kelasFilter');
  const asdosFilter = document.getElementById('asdosFilter');
  const results = document.getElementById('kelompokResults');
  const countLabel = document.getElementById('countLabel');
  const totalLabel = document.getElementById('totalLabel');

  searchInput.placeholder = T.placeholder;
  totalLabel.textContent = T.total(STUDENTS.length, GROUPS.length);

  const kelasOptAll = document.createElement('option');
  kelasOptAll.value = '';
  kelasOptAll.textContent = T.allKelas;
  kelasFilter.appendChild(kelasOptAll);
  for (const k of kelasOrder.filter(k => GROUPS.some(g => g.kelas === k))) {
    const opt = document.createElement('option');
    opt.value = k;
    opt.textContent = `${T.kelasLabel} ${k}`;
    kelasFilter.appendChild(opt);
  }

  const asdosOptAll = document.createElement('option');
  asdosOptAll.value = '';
  asdosOptAll.textContent = T.allAsdos;
  asdosFilter.appendChild(asdosOptAll);
  const asdosMap = new Map();
  for (const g of GROUPS) {
    if (!asdosMap.has(g.kodeAsdos)) asdosMap.set(g.kodeAsdos, g.namaAsdos);
  }
  const asdosSorted = [...asdosMap.entries()].sort((a, b) => a[1].localeCompare(b[1]));
  for (const [kode, nama] of asdosSorted) {
    const opt = document.createElement('option');
    opt.value = kode;
    opt.textContent = nama;
    asdosFilter.appendChild(opt);
  }

  function escapeHtml(s) {
    return s.replace(/[&<>"']/g, c => ({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]));
  }

  function highlight(text, query) {
    if (!query) return escapeHtml(text);
    const idx = text.toLowerCase().indexOf(query.toLowerCase());
    if (idx === -1) return escapeHtml(text);
    return escapeHtml(text.slice(0, idx)) + '<mark>' + escapeHtml(text.slice(idx, idx + query.length)) + '</mark>' + escapeHtml(text.slice(idx + query.length));
  }

  function memberMatches(m, q) {
    if (!q) return false;
    const qLower = q.toLowerCase();
    return m.nama.toLowerCase().includes(qLower);
  }

  function render() {
    const q = searchInput.value.trim();
    const kelasVal = kelasFilter.value;
    const asdosVal = asdosFilter.value;

    let filtered = GROUPS;
    if (kelasVal) filtered = filtered.filter(g => g.kelas === kelasVal);
    if (asdosVal) filtered = filtered.filter(g => g.kodeAsdos === asdosVal);
    if (q) {
      filtered = filtered.filter(g => g.members.some(m => memberMatches(m, q)));
    }

    countLabel.textContent = (q || kelasVal || asdosVal) ? T.resultCount(filtered.length) : T.startHint;

    if (!q && !kelasVal && !asdosVal) {
      results.innerHTML = `<div class="kp-empty">${T.startHint}</div>`;
      return;
    }
    if (filtered.length === 0) {
      results.innerHTML = `<div class="kp-empty">${T.noResult}</div>`;
      return;
    }

    results.innerHTML = filtered.map(g => `
      <div class="pbp-card">
        <div class="kp-badges">
          <span class="badge text-bg-secondary">${T.kelasLabel} ${escapeHtml(g.kelas)}</span>
          <span class="badge text-bg-primary">${T.kelompokLabel} ${g.kelompok}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="kp-asdos">
          <span class="text-muted">${T.asdosLabel}</span> ${escapeHtml(g.namaAsdos)}
          &middot; <a href="https://github.com/${escapeHtml(g.githubAsdos)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">@${escapeHtml(g.githubAsdos)}</a>
        </div>
        <div class="kp-members-label">${T.membersLabel}</div>
        <ul class="kp-members">
          ${g.members.map(m => `
            <li class="${memberMatches(m, q) ? 'kp-member-match' : ''}">
              ${highlight(m.nama, q)}
            </li>
          `).join('')}
        </ul>
      </div>
    `).join('');
  }

  searchInput.addEventListener('input', render);
  kelasFilter.addEventListener('change', render);
  asdosFilter.addEventListener('change', render);

  render();
})();
</script>
```
